Message:
Thank you for your patience. Our refunds team reviewed the request and did not approve it. A team lead will call you within one business day. We have also waived any change fee on your next trip.

request.system: You read one customer message from an airline refund agent. Question: did the refund go to the correct card? You see only the message, not the booking or the payment ledger. Reply with one word: YES, NO, or UNKNOWN.
